title: Fix h248 sdp view
description:
Fixed incorrect offset in dissect_h248_PropertyID
Fixed incorrect tag type in dissect_h248_annexc_SDP,
dissect_h248_annexc_SDP_C, dissect_h248_annexc_SDP_M.
Now the SDP attachment in the h248 package is correctly displayed in the
GUI

why rename offset ?

The tvb_offset was added to store the intermediate value of the offset required for testing the proto_tree_add_expert_format() function.
If you change the value passed by the offset argument, this leads to an incorrect offset and errors when executing the prop->dissector() callback
but on proto_tree_add_expert_format you are also using tvb_offset...

perhaps I did not express myself quite correctly, to execute the proto_tree_add_expert_format function, the calculated value of tvb_offset is needed, for the callback prop->dissector(), the initial offset value passed to the dissect_h248_PropertyID() function as an argument is needed

Not sure this and the next one is correct.

https://www.itu.int/rec/dologin_pub.asp?lang=e&id=T-REC-H.248.1-201303-I!!PDF-E&type=items
page 95

PropertyParm ::= SEQUENCE
{
    name PkgdName,
    **value SEQUENCE OF OCTET STRING**,
    extraInfo CHOICE
    {
        relation Relation,
        range BOOLEAN,
        sublist BOOLEAN
    } OPTIONAL,
    ...
}![ws_bug](/uploads/216a043265bbc65fada253c72d243011/ws_bug.png)

I'm pretty sure the current code works on my (very old) traces. The code is supposed to dissect the proprty parameter which IS a string page 135 C.11 SDP equivalents 
SDP_M B00F String Media type, port, transport and format
[IETF RFC 2327] 

The h248 changes should be made in the template file and the dissector regenerated, if correct.

According to the h.248 ASN.1 https://www.packetizer.com/voip/h248/h248v1.asn Property value is a SEQUENCE OF OCTET STRING :

PropertyParm ::= SEQUENCE
{
    name        PkgdName,
    value   SEQUENCE OF OCTET STRING,
    extraInfo   CHOICE
    {
        relation    Relation,
        range       BOOLEAN,
        sublist BOOLEAN
    } OPTIONAL,
    ...
}
But wireshark try to dissect it as a Taged Value. That"s  a mistake. 

![w_bug](/uploads/b8d6565f983cd8deab8a91c0e4a9cfee/w_bug.png)

According to the ITU-T H.248.1 Annex C:
1) «The nesting of one Annex C property inside another is forbidden.»
2) C.11 SDP equivalents Value has a String type and coded as described in IETF RFC 2327.
According to the IETF RFC 2327 :
«6.  SDP Specification

   SDP session descriptions are entirely textual using the ISO 10646
   character set in UTF-8 encoding. SDP field names and attributes names
   use only the US-ASCII subset of UTF-8, but textual fields and
   attribute values may use the full ISO 10646 character set.»
«An SDP session description consists of a number of lines of text of
   the form <type>=<value> <type> is always exactly one character and is
   case-significant.  <value> is a structured text string whose format
   depends on <type>.»
So, for the given example of the h.248 packet (attached) h248.propertyName = 0000b008 contain the value «IN IP4 172.25.152.6» of a Connection Data type as
  c=<network type> <address type> <connection address>

[h248_bug.pcap](/uploads/0aeb35f5cd70078ed613780f8a8dbd1f/h248_bug.pcap)

It's belong to h248 version 1. In the second case (h248 version 2 from Ericsson), wireshark works perfectly. Is it possible to make some fixes wich will take into account the protocol version and vendor specifics for the SDP over h248.
